insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (Base Sum Insured + Booster+ + Safeguard/Safeguard+ + ReAssure+/ReAssureX as per Policy Schedule/variant)

great.name: Room rent (default): Any room / no capping stated
great.quote: “We don’t limit your choice. Choose the room you like, but choose judiciously to protect your Sum Insured.”
great.explanation: The base wording indicates no default room rent capping/room category restriction (i.e., choose any room). (There is a separate optional ‘Room Type Modification’ feature that can restrict eligible room category if chosen.)

great.name: Built-in additional Sum Insured buffer: ReAssure+ / ReAssureX (unlimited reinstatement after first paid claim)
great.quote: “ReAssure ‘Forever’: Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured. The first paid claim in the life of the policy triggers ReAssure ‘Forever’. Once Triggered it stays for life, provided that the policy is renewed without break.”
great.explanation: This is a strong additional cover: after the first paid claim, extra Sum Insured becomes available repeatedly (unlimited times), acting as a powerful buffer beyond the base SI.

great.name: Restore/Reinstatement benefit: Unlimited (ReAssure+ / ReAssureX)
great.quote: “Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured… (this 10 Lakh will trigger unlimited times)”
great.explanation: Effectively provides unlimited reinstatement once triggered (after the first paid claim), allowing multiple claims in future even after base SI is used.

great.name: PED waiting period option as low as 12 months (variant-dependent)
great.quote: “Pre-existing Diseases… shall be excluded until the expiry of 12months/24 months/ 36 months (as per Variant selected) of continuous coverage…”
great.explanation: A 12-month PED waiting option is best-in-class (if you select the variant offering 12 months).

great.name: Specific illness/procedure waiting period option as low as 12 months (variant-dependent)
great.quote: “Specified disease/procedure waiting period… excluded until the expiry of 24 months/12 months (as per Variant Selected)…”
great.explanation: A 12-month specific-illness waiting option is better than standard (if your chosen variant offers 12 months).

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days
good.quote: “30-day waiting period… Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident…”

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover: 60 days
good.quote: “We will pay… for 60 days before the date of admission…”
good.reference: Section 4.1.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 60 days before admission, linked to the same hospitalization.

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover: 180 days
good.reference: Section 4.1.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 180 days after discharge, linked to the same hospitalization.

good.name: Domiciliary / Home care treatment covered
good.quote: “Home Care / Domiciliary Treatment… treatment availed by the insured person at home… would require care and treatment at a hospital but is actually taken at home…”
good.explanation: Provides coverage for eligible treatments taken at home, subject to conditions in the wording.

good.name: Air ambulance covered (limit up to Base Sum Insured; emergency only)
good.quote: “Air Ambulance: Only in case of Emergency. We will pay up to Base Sum Insured.”
good.reference: Section 4.1.1(a) Expenses in reaching a Hospital
good.explanation: Air ambulance is covered for emergencies, subject to hospitalization claim being payable.

bad.name: Consumables not covered by default (unless Safeguard/Safeguard+ is chosen)
bad.quote: “Annexure I - The expenses that are not covered… List I – Expenses not covered… 56 GLOVES … 57 NEBULISATION KIT … 60 MASK …”
bad.reference: Annexure I (List I – Expenses not covered); Section 4.1.20.1.1 / 4.1.21.1 (only if Safeguard/Safeguard+ opted)
bad.explanation: By default, many common consumables/non-payable items are excluded (out-of-pocket). The policy offers optional Safeguard/Safeguard+ to cover non-payables, but without that, this is a cost risk.

bad.name: No Claim Bonus / renewal bonus: not stated as a Sum Insured increase on claim-free renewal
bad.quote: “Cumulative Bonus means any increase or addition in the Sum Insured granted by the insurer without an associated increase in premium.”
bad.reference: Definition 2.1.8 (definition only; no benefit clause found)
bad.explanation: The document defines Cumulative Bonus but does not state an NCB/renewal bonus benefit (increase in SI) for this product. If absent, your Sum Insured may not grow just for being claim-free (separate from Booster+ accumulation, which is not an NCB but an unutilized-SI carry forward feature).
